Dashboard Widget

Dashboard Widgets are card-based containers for dashboard layouts. They combine a title bar with actions, chart/table/stats content areas, loading states, and responsive grid layouts.

Widget with Title & Actions

Standard widget with a header bar containing title and action buttons.

</div>

HTML
<div class="zak-card">
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border);">
    <h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1rem;">Weekly Traffic</h3>
    <span class="zak-badge">Live</span>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-card-body" style="padding: 1.25rem; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; gap: 0.5rem; height: 120px;">
    <div style="flex: 1; height: 60%; background: var(--zak-primary);"></div>
    <div style="flex: 1; height: 80%; background: var(--zak-primary);"></div>
    <div style="flex: 1; height: 45%; background: var(--zak-primary);"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<div class="zak-card" style="max-width: 360px;">
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border);">
    <h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1rem;">Quick Stats</h3>
  </div>
  <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;">
    <div style="padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-right: 1px solid var(--zak-border); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border);">
      <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">Orders</div>
      <div style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700;">1,234</div>
    </div>
    <div style="padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border);">
      <div style="font-size: 0.75rem; color: var(--zak-text-muted);">Revenue</div>
      <div style="font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700;">$48K</div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

Widget with Loading State

Show skeleton placeholders while data loads.

Top Products

HTML
<div class="zak-card" style="max-width: 360px;">
  <div style="display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border);">
    <h3 style="margin: 0; font-size: 1rem;">Top Products</h3>
    <div class="zak-spinner zak-spinner-sm"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-card-body" style="padding: 1.25rem;">
    <div class="zak-skeleton" style="width: 2rem; height: 2rem; border-radius: 4px;"></div>
    <div class="zak-skeleton" style="height: 0.875rem; width: 60%;"></div>
  </div>
</div>

HTML
<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); gap: 1rem;">
  <div class="zak-card" style="grid-column: span 2;">
    <div style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem;">Revenue Chart</div>
    <div class="zak-card-body" style="height: 120px;"></div>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-card">
    <div style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem;">Users</div>
    <div class="zak-card-body">2.4K</div>
  </div>
  <div class="zak-card">
    <div style="padding: 0.75rem 1rem; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--zak-border); font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.875rem;">Tasks</div>
    <div class="zak-card-body">84%</div>
  </div>
</div>
